Subject: High rate of 429s hitting /v1/generate — production impact

Hi Rachel,

We started seeing a spike of 429 responses from the Redwood API against our production inference endpoint beginning ~08:58 PST. ~15% of requests are getting 429 with the following sample timestamps attached. This is causing customer-facing request failures and queuing in our service.

What we observed:
- Endpoint: POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate
- First observed: 2026-11-18T08:58:09Z
- Error pattern: 429 Too Many Requests, X-RateLimit-Remaining drops to 0 suddenly
- Impact: session token failures for 12% of active users; backlog in our retry layer

We attached a short log excerpt (error-snippets.log). Can you confirm whether this is an upstream quota enforcement change or a tenant-level mapping issue? We need an ETA on mitigation and whether you can temporarily raise quota or route to fallback model.

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Ops Lead, BrightLumen

Thanks for the ping — quick triage notes below.

What I checked (08:50–09:40 PST):
- Deployment audit: there was a config push at 08:42 that adjusted tenant->quota mapping rules for a larger tenant migration test. Change-id: cfg-9872. That change introduced a fallback rule that incorrectly applied the default token-rate cap to certain tenant IDs that match the BrightLumen pattern.
- Runtime behavior: when the mapping falls through, the request is served but the per-second token allowance evaluates to the default small bucket, so many production request bursts get 429.

Immediate mitigation we applied at 09:12 PST:
- Reverted cfg-9872 for the tenant-match rule.
- Applied an emergency per-tenant override: brightlumen tenant_id=tl-0043 token_rate_limit=7500 tok/s (temporary) to drain backlog.
- Opened a short-lived routing policy to prefer model-variant 'redwood-latency-v2' with more permissive throughput for BrightLumen traffic.

Current status: 429 rate dropped from ~15% -> <1% by 09:28 PST. Alex, can you confirm your side is seeing the reduction?

Follow-ups I recommend:
- Postmortem draft with root cause and permanent fix (mapping validation and CI test for tenant regex rules).
- Tenant-quota playbook: step-by-step emergency override + when to revert.

I attached the postmortem draft and a proposed playbook. I will not publish until we align on wording with Rachel and legal.

-Karthik
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Alex — thank you for the confirmation and for the compliance requirements. Summary and next steps below.

Summary (what happened)
- Root cause: a recent config change (cfg-9872) introduced a tenant->quota mapping fallback that matched BrightLumen tenant IDs incorrectly, causing the default low token-rate bucket to be applied.
- Immediate impact: transient 429 spike, peaking ~15% affected requests between 08:58–09:20 PST on 2026-11-18.
- Mitigation performed: revert of cfg-9872, emergency per-tenant override (tl-0043 = 7500 tok/s), temporary routing to redwood-latency-v2. Errors fell to <1% by 09:28 PST.

Action items & owners
- Karthik: deliver permanent code fix that validates tenant regex matches and adds unit/integration tests for mapping rules. ETA: 48 hours (target 2026-11-20 close of day).
- Marissa: finalize tenant-quota-playbook-v1.pdf and provide a signed PDF for your SOC. ETA: 24 hours (2026-11-19 EOD).
- Rachel (me): coordinate the postmortem review and prepare a customer-facing summary. I'll also open a HubSpot activity record and attach the artifacts.
- Sean Gallagher (Escalations): will be on the postmortem call if you want a live run-through.

Artifacts provided
- Tenant quota playbook (attached PDF): tenant-quota-playbook-v1.pdf
- Draft postmortem (internal): postmortem-draft.docx
- HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/deal/78291
- Postmortem draft on Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cPostmortemDraft

1) Does BrightLumen accept the temporary per-tenant override to remain until the permanent fix is deployed? (We will notify you before rollback.)
2) Do you want us to run a short tabletop with your SOC to walk through detection and the playbook?

If you confirm the override and tabletop, we'll lock in times and provide the signed playbook PDF.

Thanks again for alerting us promptly — we know this impacted your users and appreciate the quick signal which helped us remediate faster.

Best,
